evidence.text: Service delivery manager at Stratus Harbour Hosting from 2019 to 2024, managing a service desk of nine analysts on two shifts against the customer SLAs, with a duty manager on each shift reporting to the candidate.
evidence.notes: Directly states team size, shift structure, SLA focus.

evidence.text: Named in the contract schedule as contract owner for the out-of-hours support outsourcing agreement; negotiated and signed the 2023 renewal within the delegated authority set by the chief operating officer.
Ran the major-incident bridge for priority-one incidents and sent customer status updates every 30 minutes until resolution, then chaired the post-incident review within five working days.
Presented monthly service reviews to the eight largest customers, covering SLA attainment, incident trends and open problem records, and agreed actions with each customer's IT lead.

missingEvidence: ITIL 4 Managing Professional designation not established in the provided materials.

hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: The evidence establishes that the candidate has held the role of Service Delivery Manager at Stratus Harbour Hosting, managed a nine‑analyst service desk, owned the out‑of‑hours support outsourcing contract and its renewal, led the major‑incident process with regular customer communication, and presented monthly service reviews to key customers. The candidate holds an ITIL 4 Foundation certificate and is studying for the Managing Professional modules, but no evidence of the Managing Professional designation is provided. Human review is required to confirm whether the candidate meets the ITIL 4 Managing Professional requirement and to evaluate overall fit.
limitations: No evidence of ITIL 4 Managing Professional designation; the candidate is only studying for the modules.
